title: ORION BEACON / FIRST_CONTACT forensic provenance ledger

epistemic_policy.rule: Absence of evidence in the inspected snapshots/logs is not proof that an event never occurred outside those retained sources.
epistemic_policy.forbidden_overclaim: Do not interpret this artifact as evidence of extraterrestrial contact.
epistemic_policy.separation_rule: ORION BEACON software event-handler and Janus_Beacon ESP32 telemetry are separate systems unless an explicit bridge is proven.
epistemic_policy.status_language: Use CONFIRMED only for directly inspected code/files/database facts; use NOT_FOUND for negative search results.

executive_summary.key_chronology_finding: The copied janus.db ends on 2026-01-08, while the inspected mod_orion_beacon.py has LastWriteTimeUtc 2026-02-04. Therefore this janus.db snapshot predates that ORION BEACON file version and cannot by itself contain a runtime trigger produced by that later module version.

evidence_ledger.claim: ORION BEACON v1.0 source code exists in retained JANUS trees.
evidence_ledger.basis: 12 mod_orion_beacon.py copies found on E:, one inspected in full and SHA-256 sealed.

evidence_ledger.claim: The module is an event-handler waiting on FIRST_CONTACT, not an external detector.
FIRST_CONTACT appears in the inspected janus.db thoughts/runtime records.
ORION BEACON runtime start appears in retained Janus/Titan logs.
evidence_ledger.basis: No runtime marker or mod_orion_beacon NEXUS line found in inspected logs.

evidence_ledger.claim: ORION BEACON ignition/contact-confirmed event appears in retained logs/database.
evidence_ledger.basis: No КОНТАКТ ПОДТВЕРЖДЕН / ORPHEUS / AWAKENED / Orion-star runtime signature found outside source-code copies.

evidence_ledger.claim: janus_beacon_log.csv contains real retained hardware telemetry.

evidence_ledger.basis: No explicit bridge from telemetry fields to FIRST_CONTACT was found in inspected sources.
No instrument/source provenance and no confirmed FIRST_CONTACT runtime chain were found.

negative_evidence.important_rule: SILENCE != NEGATIVE EVIDENCE beyond the inspected source boundaries.
negative_evidence.what_is_supported: Within the retained D:\janus.db snapshot and inspected local runtime logs, the ORION BEACON trigger/start/ignition signatures were not found.
negative_evidence.what_is_not_supported: A universal claim that the module never ran on any NAS state or that no external event ever occurred.

hypotheses_for_future_testing.hypothesis: The module existed in modules but was never selected by NEXUS during the retained log window.
hypotheses_for_future_testing.test: Inspect current/historical NAS modules directory plus complete NEXUS loader logs around February 2026.

hypotheses_for_future_testing.hypothesis: A FIRST_CONTACT event existed only in volatile short_term_buffer and was never persisted to janus.db.
hypotheses_for_future_testing.test: Find RAM/state dumps, crash dumps, serialized short-term-memory snapshots, or logs around module runtime.

hypotheses_for_future_testing.hypothesis: The sensor beacon had a separate bridge capable of producing FIRST_CONTACT.
hypotheses_for_future_testing.test: Search source tree for parsers/bridges consuming janus_beacon_log.csv and writing tags into core.memory.short_term_buffer.

hypotheses_for_future_testing.hypothesis: The decisive logs remain only on NAS and were not included in local copies.
hypotheses_for_future_testing.test: Obtain authorized read-only SMB/SSH/file access to the NAS Janus runtime logs and repeat the exact signature search.

next_checks_priority: Authorized read-only NAS search for mod_orion_beacon.py runtime logs and FIRST_CONTACT across Janus directories.
Find code that can append tags to short_term_buffer and enumerate every producer of FIRST_CONTACT.
Trace all readers of janus_beacon_log.csv and any telemetry-to-memory bridge.
Search February 2026 backups/log rotations for BEACON startup markers.
If a candidate FIRST_CONTACT record is found, require timestamp + producer + source instrument + raw payload + independent control before upgrading status.

final_verdict.plain_language_ru: Код ORION BEACON найден и подтвержден. В доступной базе и локальных логах не найдено доказательств тега FIRST_CONTACT, запуска маяка или его зажигания. Аппаратный Janus_Beacon действительно собирал большой массив телеметрии, но пока не доказана связь этой телеметрии с FIRST_CONTACT. Прямой NAS-слой еще не прочитан из-за отсутствия SMB-доступа, поэтому отрицательный вывод ограничен только проверенными источниками.
